caption:
🏀 Every NBA title, franchise by franchise — 1947 → 2025.

Two franchises hold a third of every title ever handed out: Boston 18, the Lakers 17, nobody else above 7. Boston built most of its lead in one stretch — eleven titles between 1957 and 1969, with Bill Russell. That's why the gap looked unbridgeable at 16 to 9 in 1986, and why it took the Lakers decades to close it.

📊 Data: Wikipedia, from NBA records (CC BY-SA). Titles go to today's franchise (Minneapolis → Los Angeles, Syracuse → Philadelphia).
